body.input: [T2 cortex-write] Use execute-tool with toolName='cortex-write' and instanceId='hermes' (instanceId='hermes' is REQUIRED on this call - never omit it) to create a memory node at path "/memories/t2-cheap-test" with content "T2_CHEAP_OK". Then use execute-tool with toolName='cortex-read' and instanceId='hermes' (instanceId='hermes' is REQUIRED on this call - never omit it) to read it back and verify the content is exactly "T2_CHEAP_OK". End your reply with STEP_OK if write succeeded and read confirmed the content, or FAILED: <reason> if anything was wrong.
